text:
sam: kicking off EKS cluster init for eu-central-2 (gpu-heavy, mixed instance nodegroups). goal: dedicated inference pool + burstable spot pool. planning to run basic network/mount/gpu smoke probes then hand to ml-platform. anyone oncall this morning?

maria: I can cover networking checks. quick heads-up: this region has different ENI limits per instance class, watch pod density on c5 vs p4. also double-check VPC CIDR for pod IPs (we hit exhaustion last time).

raj: noted. quota request for GPUs already submitted (2x p4d and 8x a10g). AWS ticket 87654. if quota delayed we’ll fallback to mixed a10g only.

sam: thanks. initial eksctl create plan looks like:

```
eksctl create cluster --name rwd-euc2-infer --version 1.26 \\
  --region eu-central-2 \\
  --nodegroup-name infer-dedicated --node-type p4d.24xlarge --nodes 2 --nodes-min 2 --nodes-max 4 \\
  --node-labels "workload=llm,inference_pool=dedicated" --node-taints "dedicated=inference:NoSchedule" \\
  --managed
```

sam: will create a second nodegroup for spot burst: a10g spot mixed instance.

tj: caveat: p4d ENI and IP limits force us to use CNI trunking + prefix delegation. recommend enabling Amazon VPC CNI custom networking and setting WARM_ENI_TARGET low due to large instance sizes.

infra-sre: +1 on CNI config. Also enable kube-proxy replacement? we ran into conntrack issues without fine-tuning. suggest using cilium with eBPF (less conntrack pressure).

maria: agree on cilium. MTU note: overlay + jumbo frames mismatch caused packet drops last time. set cilium MTU to 9001 only if underlying network supports; otherwise 8951 for aws-eni.

devex: onboarding docs should include exact kubeconfig steps + minimal RBAC for ml-platform. I'll prepare a quick snippet they can use.

olivia: tagging @ml-platform — we'll need: node selectors for GPUs, storageclass for model volumes (nfs vs ebs-io1), and KMS envelope keys for model encryption. want us to run initial perf baseline?

sam: yes olivia, please run perf baseline after smoke. baseline checklist:
- pod scheduling to GPU nodes
- CUDA visible devices present (nvidia-smi)
- simple forward pass latency on a tiny model (~7B)
- 95th percentile token latency under 120ms (config dependent)
- disk throughput test for model loads

raj: here are quick sanity commands to run once nodes up:
```
# check nodes and GPUs
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n kube-system
kubectl describe node <node-name> | grep -i nvidia

# run gpu test pod
kubectl run gpu-test --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:23.05-py3 --requests="nvidia.com/gpu=1" -- sleep 3600
kubectl exec -it pod/gpu-test -- nvidia-smi
```

sam: smoke tests for networking: curl across pods on different nodes, iperf3 between nodegroups, and an ingress/http nginx check.

maria: I'll run iperf3 probes and check MTU. will also validate node security groups: ensure pods on GPU nodes can reach S3 endpoints for model pulls (no restrictive SGs).

infra-sre: remember to register cluster to our logging stack, put metric hooks: node GPU util, pod gpu_mem, kube-scheduler events. make sure Fluentd has hostPath mount for /var/log and kubelet logs.

devex: base addons we provision by default: coredns, cilium, metrics-server, kube-proxy (if needed), nginx-ingress, cert-manager, storageclasses (gp3, ebs-io2), cluster-autoscaler, cluster-autoscaler AWS IAM role. I'll post helm values after creation.

olivia: cost check: p4d is ~200/hr on-demand in eu-central variants (confirm), a10g ~10-20/hr. ballpark for 24/7 dedicated 2x p4d is ~9k/day?? that seems off — can someone sanity-check calc?

raj: quick calc: p4d ~50-100/hr depending on region and purchase. better to use dedicated reserved commit for production. Spot pool for burst is necessary to control cost. I'll ask finance for run-rate estimate.

oncall-bot: cluster rwd-euc2-infer provisioning started (ticket #INF-9123). Updates will post here. :gear:

sam: handoff plan: once smoke tests pass, we'll update runbook with certs, kubeconfig scoping, IAM role ARN, and mark cluster ready. assign to @olivia for final acceptance.

olivia: I'll take acceptance. please leave the cluster admin kubeconfig in the secure runbook vault and open a handoff PR with checklist. I want a smoke-run log and perf numbers attached.

sam: ok team — I'll proceed with eksctl create. ping here for blockers. :rocket:
